The robots are performing tasks like logistics, assembly assistance, and quality inspection alongside human workers on the production line, marking a significant step for humanoid integration in China's automotive manufacturing sector.

item.description: Pudu Robotics has introduced the FlashBot Arm, a service robot that integrates dual 7-DOF arms and dexterous hands onto a mobile delivery base. Designed for tasks like operating elevators and opening doors, it aims to combine autonomous navigation with manipulation capabilities for greater versatility in service environments.

item.title: Movin Raises $2.7 Million to Revolutionize Humanoid Robotics with Lidar Motion Capture
item.description: South Korean startup Movin has raised $2.7 million in pre-Series A funding to expand its Lidar-based motion capture technology for humanoid robots.
